data.body: Implementation pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1041 (change 1041). New det_gate_rules.py (DetGateRule + overlay/leaf tables; registry re-exports — the verbatim audit vocabularies would breach the 800-LOC cap in registry.py), route_criteria gate_log + leaf-gate block, assemble-step routing.det_gated coverage, ADR 0034 amendment, routing trigger annotations, 72 new unit tests. Full unit suite green locally except two PRE-EXISTING failures in tests/unit/test_plan_review_reuse.py (test_force_bypasses_verdict_reuse / test_code_change_reruns_full_review) that reproduce identically on clean origin/main in this environment — not introduced by this change; CI is the authority.
